actual_problem: A sufficient rollout preview cannot yet become an accountable, bounded activation decision with observable stop and rollback conditions.
why_it_matters: Activation without explicit authority, observation, and rollback can silently accept or suspend knowledge beyond the intended risk appetite.
why_now: QIF v0.8.6 completed exhaustive pre-activation census; current agent governance is moving from static policy toward continuous controls, canaries, circuit breakers, and auditable authorization.
